aesthetics.typography: Star4000 (pixel-style retro WeatherStar bitmap font) for nearly everything: inputs at 21px, labels/info at 16px, small inputs 13px; GitHub buttons use -apple-system 14px/600
aesthetics.typeScale: Flat: almost all text 16px regular Star4000; location input 21px; GitHub buttons 14px semibold; no headings

notes: WeatherStar 4000+ (ws4kp) — recreates the 1990s Weather Channel local forecast display. The page itself is unstyled browser-default HTML set entirely in the Star4000 pixel font, left-aligned in a ~640px column with the rest of the 1440 viewport blank white. The player is a black frame with chunky white glyph controls on both sides and a duplicated mini control bar; the weather iframe in the capture appears clipped to 150px height (title 'Latest Observat...' cut off). Default square grey (#e0e0e0) buttons with 1px black borders contrast with the rounded GitHub-styled buttons. Settings apply instantly via radios; text options use small 'Set' buttons. Auto Refresh shows a live countdown.
